programme.desc: Stan finds a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Could it really lead to finding the lost booty of dreaded pirate Abby Birdy? Tha Dan air mapa-ulaidh a lorg ann am botal air an tràigh. Saoil an toir seo 'ad gu bhith a' lorg ulaidh na pioraid oillteil, Labraidh Sona?

programme.title: Beathaichean a’ Bocadaich
programme.desc: Tha Sophie a’ coimhead tron phrosbaig sheunta aice airson faicinn ciamar a bhios beathaichean a’ bocadaich. Tha i ag ionnsachadh mar a bhios diofar bheathaichean a’ gluasad agus cuide ri a caraidean, tha i a’ cruthachadh dannsa. An-diugh, danns coltach ri mathan agus cearban! Sophie looks through her magic binoculars to find out how animals boogie. She learns how different animals dance and, along with her friends, creates a dance using animal movements. Join her and dance like a bear and a shark!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan a’ campachadh a-muigh le teant, geansaidhean agus marsmalothan. On a chilly day, the Froglets enjoy camping outside with a tent, sweaters and marshmallows.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Beag Chlangair den bheachd gun do thuit an iomhas fanais às an fhànais ach chan eil e cinnteach dè th’ ann. Small Clanger thinks that some treasure fell from space, but he’s not at all sure what it is.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Nuair tha ròbot a’ nochdadh air a’ phlanaid, tha e a' sealltainn dha na Clangairean far an do shiubhail e chun a seo – ‘s le taic bho Beag Chlangair, tha e ga fhaicinn fhèin 'son a’ chiad turas. When a robot appears on the planet, he shows the Clangers where he has travelled so far. With help from Beag Chlangair, he sees a picture of himself for the first time.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Ruairidh Gray a’ leughadh An t-Òran dhan a h-uile Duine. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Lucy Morris agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Màiri NicCumhais. Ruairidh Gray reads An t-Òran dhan a h-uile Duine, written and illustrated by Lucy Morris and translated into Gaelic by Mairi MacCuish.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: ‘S toil le Carlota bhith rèiseadh mhotor-baidhseagalan. Bidh daoine ag ràdh g’ eil i luath ‘s mar sin bidh iAd a' toirt Cheetah oirre. Agus an uair a chur i dath na falt ‘s e an Cheetah Gorm a thug iad oirre. Carlota loves to race motorbikes fast which earned her the nickname Cheetah. So when she coloured her hair, they renamed her the Blue Cheetah.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair nach eil sgeul air Belle, tha Sebastian draghail oir 's e seo an treas trup an t-seachdain seo – 's tha e 'g ionndrainn an caidreadh maidne aca. Ach dè tha ag adhbharachadh seo? When Belle is nowhere to be seen, Sebastian is anxious as this is the third time this week, and he misses their morning hugs. But what could be causing this?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh agus a charaidean a' faireachdainn fàileadh uabhasach, saoil dè nì iad leis an tuathanach? The farmer's personal hygiene leaves much to be desired.

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: Thòisich tramaichean a’ ruith ann an Dùn Èideann ann an 2014 agus an-diugh tha faisg air 20,000 duine gan chleachdadh gach latha. The Calum agus a cho-ogha Ruairidh Iain anns a’ bhaile airson barrachd innse dhuinn mun deidhinn. Trams started running in Edinburgh in 2014 and now nearly 20,000 people use them every day. Calum and his cousin Ruairidh Iain visit the city to tell us a bit more about them.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach. Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Dùbhlain DIY (Instructions Not Included)
programme.desc: Derek 'Pluto' Murray hosts a fun knockout amateur DIY competition where couples go head to head. Derek 'Pluto' Moireach le farpais spòrsail DIY is cupail a’ strì an aghaidh a chèile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Miriam Donaghey from the Isle of Lewis is Joy’s guest in the studio, and Calum Maclean is in a park in Edinburgh as he tests out an activity he’s never heard of or tried before!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Sona
programme.desc: Tha Vicky Kilgour air turas rathaid a’ sireadh toileachas is slàinte sna saunathan air Taobh Siar na h-Alba, le a caraid Donnchadh Dòmhnallach. Sa phrògram seo, seallaidh i dhà feadhainn dhe na cur-seachadan aice, agus chan eil e chofhurtail le cuid dhiubh. An Earra-Ghàidheal, feuchaidh iad snàmh fiadhaich, amaran puill, sgùradh salainn, is snorcaladh, le measgachadh de dhaoine iongantach. Sauna lover Vicky Kilgour embarks on a road trip up Scotland’s west coast in search of wellbeing and happiness, with friend Duncan MacDonald along for the ride. In this episode, she introduces her happy place, but it's on the edge of his comfort zone. In Argyll, they dive into wild swimming, seaweed foraging, mud baths, salt scrubs and snorkelling, meeting incredible people along the way. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Greenland: Sgeul Isobel Wylie Hutchison
programme.desc: Kirsty MacDonald follows in the footsteps of pioneering Scottish adventurer Isobel Wylie Hutchison.

programme.title: Transatlantic Sessions
programme.desc: This episode includes musical stars Aly Bain, Emmylou Harris, Mary Chapin Carpenter, John Martyn and Kathy Mattea.

programme.title: Luchd-Brathaidh Cogaidh | Spies of War
programme.desc: An Lùnastal 1949: ceithir bliadhna an dèidh do na Stàitean Aonaichte boma niùclasach a chleachdadh, tha an t-Aonadh Sobhietach air am boma aca fhèin a chruthachadh. Cha robh dùil ri seo cho luath. Air cùl ghnothaichean, tha lìonra farsaing de luch-brathaidh air fiosrachadh dìomhair a lìbhrigeadh gu na Sobhietaich. Ionnsaich mar a thug luchd-saidheans seachad fiosrachadh mun bhoma – agus mar a chaidh an còd aca a bhriseadh. In August 1949, four years after the US drops the atomic bomb, the Soviets detonate one. No-one expected it so soon. Behind the scenes, a vast Soviet spy network helps deliver the secret. Discover how scientists passed on the bomb’s secrets, and how their code was broken. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Am buannaiche dhuaisean Hannah Rarity agus còmhlan-ciùil, clàraichte beò aig Duaisean nan Trads 2025 ann an Obar Dheathain. Anns an t-seata, The Leaving agus Christmas Came Early. Award-winning singer Hannah Rarity and band, recorded live at the 2025 Trad Awards in Aberdeen. The set includes The Leaving and Christmas Came Early.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take you so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. In the third of the quarter-finals, three studying for their PhDs at Oxford set out to challenge the brainpower of the strategists, a team unified by their love of sophisticated strategy board games. They compete to draw together the connections between things, which, at first glance, seem utterly random - from maypoles to horse racing to spoken theatre to mince pies.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Washington’s Continental Army emerges from the harsh winter at Valley Forge to fight the British Army in the inconclusive Battle of Monmouth. But the alliance with France changes the war and moves it to other theatres, and armies advance into Indian country and the southern states. Together, the British Army and Navy capture Charleston. A film by Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt.

programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox journeys into a supermassive black hole - a monster that can destroy worlds and stop time, and which is forcing us to reassess our understanding of reality.

programme.title: The Nazis: A Warning from History
programme.desc: Nearly one in five Poles died during World War II after the Nazi invasion in 1939 ushered in one of the most brutal episodes of ethnic cleansing the world has ever seen. This film destroys the myth that Poland's Nazi leaders were acting under detailed 'orders' and that the country's Nazi administration was a model of German efficiency. Arthur Greiser and Albert Forster, the two Nazi leaders charged with Germanising Poland, could not even agree on who should be Germanised. Featuring interviews with former Nazis, moving testimony from witnesses to SS atrocities in Poland, ethnic Germans and Polish Jews, the programme provides insights into how the Nazis' reign of terror in Poland was characterised by huge population upheavals, chaos, petty squabbles and sheer bloodlust.

programme.title: One Foot in the Past
programme.desc: Lucinda Lambton visits Europe's last ornamental farm, at Larchill, west of Dublin. It features rustic follies, great lakes and a glorious collection of animals.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: To mark the rescreening of Our Friends in the North, as part of the BBC’s centenary celebrations, Christopher Eccleston looks back on Peter Flannery’s acclaimed 1996 drama. Following the lives of four friends from Newcastle over a period of three decades, the series struck a chord with the nation’s viewers and turned its young cast into household names. In this introduction to the series, Eccleston shares behind-the-scenes stories of how the drama was made and assesses the impact it had on audiences, himself and his fellow cast members.

programme.desc: Geordie works in Barratt's porn empire, Nicky is a political activist - the reunion is disaster. Both are wanted by the police. Tosker is a businessman, Mary a local politician.

No-one wants this trip to end, but as strange things start to happen, Frida begins to question what is real and what is not. There is something wrong with this place. She will have to uncover the truth if she wants to make it out of this party alive.

programme.desc: England enter the knockout stages of the 2026 FIFA World Cup with a round of 32 clash against DR Congo in Atlanta. programme.title: Blink Twice
programme.desc: When tech billionaire Slater King meets cocktail waitress Frida at his fundraising gala, sparks fly. He invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. Wild nights blend into sun-soaked days, and everyone is having a great time. No-one wants this trip to end, but as strange things start to happen, Frida begins to question what is real and what is not. There is something wrong with this place. She will have to uncover the truth if she wants to make it out of this party alive.

programme.title: Would I Lie to You?
programme.desc: Rob Brydon is back in the host’s chair for the award-winning comedy panel show, with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Celebrity guests Bez, Motsi Mabuse, Shazia Mirza and Steve Pemberton reveal extraordinary stories about themselves, but are they telling the truth or making it all up?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: 2026 FIFA World Cup co-host USA target a place in the last 16, having impressed so far in winning their group with a game to spare. Under Mauricio Pochettino belief among American supporters is growing that they can be contenders for the trophy. Bosnia and Herzegovina, meanwhile, have made the knockout stages for the first time at their second World Cup.

He invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. Wild nights blend into sun-soaked days, and everyone is having a great time. No-one wants this trip to end, but as strange things start to happen, Frida begins to question what is real and what is not. There is something wrong with this place. She will have to uncover the truth if she wants to make it out of this party alive.

programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: More from the day’s top stories and communities across Scotland.

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: Ian Hamilton and guide dog, Major, head to Cumnock in East Ayrshire. Once a thriving mining town, Cumnock now has an ambition to become Scotland’s first green town by running its own hi-tech renewable energy system and making use of digital and smart technologies. Digging below the surface of these ambitious plans for the town, Ian meets the locals to see what they think about it all, and also to find out what smaller steps they are taking to move towards a greener world. Cumnock provided coal to power the country for generations and is now is hoping to transform its future.

programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: Ardrossan port staff deal with delays, while the Oban pier team face a charity challenge that has them gagging. Meanwhile, it’s the first day of school for an island schoolboy.

programme.title: Body on the Beach: What Happened to Annie?
programme.desc: Hazel explores the conditions at Prestwick beach. Did Annie really drown herself there? Remarkable forensic evidence suggests otherwise.

programme.title: Body on the Beach: What Happened to Annie?
programme.desc: In the final episode, Hazel gets access to a new source of information and makes a series of disturbing discoveries which shed new light on what happened to Annie.

programme.title: River City
programme.desc: A concerned Amber attempts to support a spiralling Alex but grows suspicious of Lydia in the process, and DCI Douglas gets more than he bargained for in his pursuit of Harry. Meanwhile, a frustrated Kelly-Marie takes a firmer approach with Callum, and intent on giving up, Drew confides in Maggie.

programme.title: Not Your Average Family
programme.desc: Trans influencer Charlie stops testosterone to restart his menstrual cycle, with dramatic consequences. Meanwhile, Lauren prepares for motherhood by facing her debilitating fear of sickness. With family planning under way, the couple lay down the financial foundations by investing their online cash into a real-life business venture.

programme.title: Not Your Average Family
programme.desc: Charlie and Lauren are flying high after their first fertility clinic consultation and trip to London for the British LGBT Awards. However, it’s back to earth with a bump after they fall victim to a targeted hate crime. Now, they are more determined than ever to open their inclusive salon as a safe space for the LGBTQ community.

programme.title: Not Your Average Family
programme.desc: Charlie and Lauren deal with difficult fertility news, but with a business to open in a matter of months, there is no time to delay. It’s all hands on deck to launch their safe space salon, amidst a backdrop of rising tension over trans rights in the UK, as Westminster blocks the Scottish Gender Recognition Reform Bill.

programme.title: The Catch Up
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Wildlife guru Steve Backshall is in Australia, searching for animals to add to his Deadly 60 list. Out in the forest, Steve has to have his wits about him when he comes face to face with a huge lace monitor lizard. Australian schoolchildren are taught to respect the continent's deadliest arachnid, the redback spider. Hidden deep in a barn, Steve has an encounter with a redback that has the crew holding their breath.

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Max is left rattled by Priya’s behaviour. Cindy and Max toast their engagement in the Vic. Bea’s influence intensifies.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May head to Albania to test the super-luxurious Rolls-Royce Ghost, Bentley Mulsanne and Mercedes S65 AMG. Back on home soil, Jeremy is out on the track in a trio of high-powered hatchbacks - the Ford Focus RS500, the Prodrive Impreza CS400 and the one-off Volvo C30 PPC - whilst Jonathan Ross is the Star in the Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: A Cock and Bull Story
programme.desc: An imaginative and witty adaptation of Laurence Sterne's 'unfilmable' novel The Life and Opinions of Tristram Shandy, Gentleman. Tristram Shandy, played by Steve Coogan, guides viewers through the epic tale of his life and opinions, chopping back and forth in time, commenting on his tale as he tells it.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: The gang belatedly get involved in the Great Famine, the one thing they didn’t need to get involved in. Callum’s new job at the Ballymac Folk Museum sends him down a spiral of method acting as a starving peasant. And he’s helped along in this grovelling subservience by his new boss, tyrannical land steward Phillip. The sudden news, to Jordan, that a million people died during the potato famine causes him to finally develop empathy, and it turns out to be a real pain.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Strange things are afoot in Ballymacnoose: animals in small clothing, paranormal sightings of leprechauns, and most bizarrely of all, Callum gets his first ever match on a dating app. The one prickle on the pickle is that Gwen, Callum’s dream girl, is also in an open relationship with the 50-year-old Grainne, a woman who disembowels chickens for a living. Meanwhile, Gemma becomes obsessed with dressing farm animals in tiny clothing and causes Sammy to spin out in paranoia thinking that his farm has become infested with leprechauns. So Lorcan has no other choice but to introduce Gemma to the dark secrets of the Ballymacnoose Paranormal Society, also run by his da and Frank.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Life in Ballymacnoose becomes very complicated when Callum accidentally walks in on Gemma and Lorcan trying out a new form of lovemaking. The sight triggers a long-buried childhood trauma in Callum and raises uncomfortable questions about the town’s deeply repressed relationship with sex. Can Ballymacnoose open its heart to true love? Meanwhile, Jordan has officially begun dating his much older lover, 50-year-old Grainne. But as their relationship deepens, Jordan is confronted with another harsh reality of adulthood: he’s going bald. Faced with the slow retreat of his hairline and the love of a good woman, Jordan must decide whether to cling to denial or embrace manhood in all its forms - love, responsibility and mushroom carbonaras.

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: As Callum begins slowly unravelling under the strain of Jordan's relentless night terrors about baldness, he stumbles upon a flyer for Ballymacbot Wars - a local robot combat tournament offering a generous cash prize and potential ticket out of Jordan’s bedroom. Meanwhile, Jordan is uncharacteristically uninterested in the whole affair. He's become a bald hermit, terrified to leave the house and expose his creamy scalp to the outside world. That is, until, like a dagger in the night, a hooded burst of inspiration sends him back out into the world… and the robot wars.

The sudden news, to Jordan, that a million people died during the potato famine causes him to finally develop empathy, and it turns out to be a real pain.

Meanwhile, Gemma becomes obsessed with dressing farm animals in tiny clothing and causes Sammy to spin out in paranoia thinking that his farm has become infested with leprechauns. programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Punk Chef returns for more Cafe Conversations, where he meets guests in an informal cafe setting over coffee, with stories, laughter and personality revelations that explore whether drink choices reflect who people really are. He's joined first by Jenny Sealey, artistic director of Graeae Theatre Company, who shares a warm, funny and deeply honest conversation about her life, career and lived experience of becoming deaf at the age of seven. Next up is Nathan Rollinson, luxury brand consultant and content creator, who brings a vibrant and energetic presence to the table. Nathan talks about his multiple roles across social media, photography, fashion and consultancy.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Jeff Brazier presents an appeal on behalf of the Katie Piper Foundation, a charity that helps survivors of burns and trauma recover and rebuild their lives by offering physical, psychological and family support.

programme.title: Springwatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan broadcast live from National Trust Crom in Northern Ireland, where the nests they’ve been watching for weeks are bursting at the seams with fledging chicks. Who will stay and who will go? Iolo Williams is experiencing the captivating cacophony resonating from the seabird colonies at Bempton, on the spectacular Yorkshire coast, plus more celebrations of the wonderful cast of British wildlife up and down the country.

programme.title: In Ten Pictures
programme.desc: On 17 August 1996, 21-year-old David Beckham raised his hands to the sky, having just scored against Wimbledon from his own half. That iconic image turned Beckham into a household name and kickstarted a relationship with image-making that would propel the footballer into the popular imagination and help redefine modern celebrity. But behind the popular narrative is a deeper story: of how the footballer used his image to turn himself into a global brand – one that went far beyond the limits of his extraordinary footballing skills – and in so doing helped change attitudes to celebrity, masculinity and class.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: They have been raising smiles for centuries, and in this episode, Eric Knowles learns about a unique clowning tradition. No two clowns should look alike, which is why their faces are copyrighted – on painted eggs! Professional clown Mattie Faint prompts a chuckle or two from Eric when he explains this egg-centric custom. Topping the bill on this show are two teams of antiques hunters, browsing hundreds of stalls at a huge fair with experts Nick Hall and Izzie Balmer. With 60 minutes on the clock, grandmother and granddaughter Karen and Amelia stew over an art deco tea set, while the reds, friends Stuart and Martin, reckon they spy a profit with a pair of mother of pearl opera glasses. Selling their items is auctioneer Charles Hanson in nearby Derbyshire. Which team is his money on?

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Izzie and JJ help Michael and Clara clear their busy home and revive forgotten gems to sell at auction, but will they raise enough to give Michael’s parents a day out to remember?

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: One of Japan’s cultural highlights is the tea ceremony. Michael visits a Kyushu tea farm where morning fog shades the tea plants, helping the leaves grow greener and richer in flavour. Michael takes one of the newest Shinkansen lines to Nagasaki, the only port open to foreign trade when Japan was closed to the outside world for more than 200 years. Michael learns of the Scottish industrialist Thomas Glover, who helped samurai clans overthrow the shogun and played a pivotal role in Japan’s industrialisation. There is also a boat trip to visit a remarkable coal-mining island, first developed in the 1890s, which grew into a small town with schools, barbers and a cinema. During the 1960s, it had a population density nine times that of central Tokyo.

programme.title: Great Central Asian Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s railway adventure in Uzbekistan continues in Samarkand, one of the oldest cities in Central Asia. Michael discovers the national passion for bread, which leads him to a family bakery where he learns how to bake special, bagel-like loaves. The great conqueror Tamerlane made Samarkand his capital in the 14th century, and at his tomb, Michael learns of the brutality and military prowess of the man who is today Uzbekistan’s national hero. The region’s global prominence grew out of the silk trade, with silk carpets being the ultimate luxury. Michael learns how secret codes are woven into traditional patterns and appreciates the skill that makes these carpets sell for tens of thousands of pounds.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: Every lifeboat volunteer undergoes hundreds of hours of training to get them up to the level of expertise needed to join a crew. But even with the best instruction available, a crew member’s first shout can still be a leap into the unknown. For sheep farmer Emma, based in St Davids on the Pembrokeshire coast, her first rescue is a real test of character - a rock climber who’s fallen into the water and is within seconds of falling unconscious. In Minehead, three kayakers are swept out to sea as darkness falls, and when only one makes it back to raise the alarm, young crew member Matt faces his first ever shout at night - an increasingly desperate search in complete darkness. It’s not just rookie crew members who face a baptism of fire - in Peterhead, after years on the crew, Patrick’s first shout as coxswain is to try to rescue a 170-ton fishing boat that’s lost all power and is perilously close to the rocks in gale force winds and heavy seas.

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Max is left rattled by Priya’s behaviour. Cindy and Max toast their engagement in the Vic. Bea’s influence intensifies.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob head to the beautiful River Ouse in the heart of Bedfordshire. The river was once famous for barbel, but has recently become renowned for its big perch instead, a fish that has so far eluded them. After a long day fishing under the summer sun on the Turvey estate, Bob prepares a dinner that Paul will never forget - slow-cooked tripe.

programme.title: Scams & Scandals
programme.desc: The dramatic theft of a £5m gold toilet from an exhibition at Blenheim Palace in 2019 became instantly one of the country’s most high-profile art heists. Now, this BBC investigation reveals how the crime was carried out and explores what’s likely to have happened to the conspicuous golden toilet once it entered the criminal supply chain. Will police recover the gold or any of the ill-gotten gains?

Inside Giovanna’s bag is a toy camera, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that are themed around a day out. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate toys and objects inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Looking Out on Our Day Out features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring things that are themed around a day out too. The Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.desc: Black and White arrive in Colourland. Learn about two colours that are very different from the other Colourblocks.

programme.desc: Aness wants to find out about brilliant bats. Chantelle is in London to meet Sophie for a night-time adventure as bat detectives, while Rory and his son Sandy are at a country park looking for bat clues. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain how bats fly, why they hang upside down, how many kinds of bats there are and what they eat. It’s also time to find out how bats help the planet as predators and pest controllers. Sandy’s friend Zoe joins for this episode’s Teeny Tiny Task – making a brilliant bat poster.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet and Mum make delicious pakora together for a special family meal to celebrate Vaisakhi. They set the table and exchange beautiful Vaisakhi cards with Dad, but what will everyone think of Amanpreet’s fabulous feast? Later, Amanpreet and Mum get crafty and paint portraits of each other. Mum’s a bit nervous, but artist Amanpreet encourages her to show her creative side.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Talented young chef Ben is cooking German zwiebelkuchen. Ben's parents are German, and zwiebelkuchen is a very popular recipe in Germany. It is one of Ben's favourite foods, so he is very happy to teach us all to make it. Zwiebelkuchen is an onion tart that is made from pastry, onions and German ham. Ben is adding lots of extra flavour by using caraway seeds. Unfortunately, his friends don't like the taste of caraway seeds on their own, so let's hope that Ben can change their minds when they taste his dish. We find out more about caraway seeds and how they are grown, and we learn more about Germany whilst Ben is busy cooking.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is at a train museum finding out how signal boxes work and how trains are moved from one track to another to get to the right place. Maddie puts her special camera on the front of a train so we can see what happens to the points when the train switches from one track to another. Next, Maddie visits a paint factory to find out how paint is made. She uses her special camera to see inside the huge mixing vat where all the different ingredients are being mixed together, and we see how a computer is used to make all the different colours.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Cocker spaniel Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means Rayane doesn’t hear everything. Diesel’s superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! Diesel has to ignore lots of noises on the way to the pet shop. He uses his superhearing to zoom in on the important sounds like the pet shop door bell. Diesel helps Rayane find the pet food aisle, where he chooses his pet food and a new toy, while being careful to choose one without a squeaker. Squeakers are for training time, not playtime. But then there’s an emergency at the cafe when the smoke alarm goes off, and the cafe has to be evacuated. Diesel must use all his training – and his superears - to help guide Rayane and Mum to safety.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet some agile gibbons who show them how well they can move. Though the gibbons are a little quiet, Steve and Aneeshwar have a go at showing what they sound like in the wild. Next, they meet a tall, long-legged bird called a seriema who is very interested in a pretend toy snake, before they reveal the unusual wild connection between the two animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: Puffin Rock

programme.title: Yukee

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels have made a song. They enjoy playing for others but wish they had a chance to see how they perform together. There is a lot to prepare beforehand, such as lights, costumes and glitter, and as they prepare, we are immersed into Enid’s dream, where she gives a star performance in her own eclectic music video! The Squirrels are taught to practice their dance moves before filming, to pick the perfect location and to try and put something unexpected into the video. After lots of collaboration, creativity and fun, the Squirrels finally get to watch their own music video and are thrilled at the results.

When a flying saucer crash-lands, F makes a new friend: Fred, who misses his mummy and wants to go home. Can her friends give F the boost she needs to fly Fred to the final frontier? This episode introduces the letter F and the words fog, fun, fin and fan.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. It is raining inside Mr Tumble's house! Meanwhile, Justin and his friends have lots of fun playing with water and sand.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 220 million years to the time of postosuchus - a giant crocodile-like creature that roamed North America in the time of the earliest dinosaurs. Before dinosaurs came along, he was the biggest meat eater on the planet, with a set of teeth to be proud of. So much so, in fact, that Hatty's display is all about the postosuchus's teeth - except they've all gone missing! Andy's mission is to track down a postosuchus and make himself some plaster copies of its teeth. Not an easy task, given it would happily take a bite out of him given half a chance!

programme.title: Molly and Mack

programme.title: My Petsaurus

programme.title: Teletubbies

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome little ones Oakley, Arthur, Luna, Reau, Ty’lana and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag is a toy camera, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that are themed around a day out. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate toys and objects inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song Looking Out on Our Day Out features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring things that are themed around a day out too. The Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create crowns from natural treasures they find from the ground, learn BSL signs for blackbird, pie and queen, then sing and sign Sing a Song of Sixpence.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Adrian, Mia and Aaron go on a 'tree-mendous' garden adventure to discover the magical powers of trees.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bean the warthog plays detective and tracks down some tasty milk. Hamza spots beautiful birds in the wild and checks on a few wild rhinos with Ranger Godfrey.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Bananaraptors shed their skin and become soft and limp, which is anything but intimidating!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Not wanting to go to bed, Bluey tries to dream about being a nocturnal fruit bat so she can stay up all night long, and soon she finds herself flying through the night sky.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Black and White arrive in Colourland. Learn about two colours that are very different from the other Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Aness wants to find out about brilliant bats. Chantelle is in London to meet Sophie for a night-time adventure as bat detectives, while Rory and his son Sandy are at a country park looking for bat clues. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain how bats fly, why they hang upside down, how many kinds of bats there are and what they eat. It’s also time to find out how bats help the planet as predators and pest controllers. Sandy’s friend Zoe joins for this episode’s Teeny Tiny Task – making a brilliant bat poster.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet and Mum make delicious pakora together for a special family meal to celebrate Vaisakhi. They set the table and exchange beautiful Vaisakhi cards with Dad, but what will everyone think of Amanpreet’s fabulous feast? Later, Amanpreet and Mum get crafty and paint portraits of each other. Mum’s a bit nervous, but artist Amanpreet encourages her to show her creative side.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Talented young chef Ben is cooking German zwiebelkuchen. Ben's parents are German, and zwiebelkuchen is a very popular recipe in Germany. It is one of Ben's favourite foods, so he is very happy to teach us all to make it. Zwiebelkuchen is an onion tart that is made from pastry, onions and German ham. Ben is adding lots of extra flavour by using caraway seeds. Unfortunately, his friends don't like the taste of caraway seeds on their own, so let's hope that Ben can change their minds when they taste his dish. We find out more about caraway seeds and how they are grown, and we learn more about Germany whilst Ben is busy cooking.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is at a train museum finding out how signal boxes work and how trains are moved from one track to another to get to the right place. Maddie puts her special camera on the front of a train so we can see what happens to the points when the train switches from one track to another. Next, Maddie visits a paint factory to find out how paint is made. She uses her special camera to see inside the huge mixing vat where all the different ingredients are being mixed together, and we see how a computer is used to make all the different colours.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Cocker spaniel Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means Rayane doesn’t hear everything. Diesel’s superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears! Diesel has to ignore lots of noises on the way to the pet shop. He uses his superhearing to zoom in on the important sounds like the pet shop door bell. Diesel helps Rayane find the pet food aisle, where he chooses his pet food and a new toy, while being careful to choose one without a squeaker. Squeakers are for training time, not playtime. But then there’s an emergency at the cafe when the smoke alarm goes off, and the cafe has to be evacuated. Diesel must use all his training – and his superears - to help guide Rayane and Mum to safety.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet some agile gibbons who show them how well they can move. Though the gibbons are a little quiet, Steve and Aneeshwar have a go at showing what they sound like in the wild. Next, they meet a tall, long-legged bird called a seriema who is very interested in a pretend toy snake, before they reveal the unusual wild connection between the two animals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels have made a song. They enjoy playing for others but wish they had a chance to see how they perform together. There is a lot to prepare beforehand, such as lights, costumes and glitter, and as they prepare, we are immersed into Enid’s dream, where she gives a star performance in her own eclectic music video! The Squirrels are taught to practice their dance moves before filming, to pick the perfect location and to try and put something unexpected into the video. After lots of collaboration, creativity and fun, the Squirrels finally get to watch their own music video and are thrilled at the results.

This episode introduces the letter F and the words fog, fun, fin and fan.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 220 million years to the time of postosuchus - a giant crocodile-like creature that roamed North America in the time of the earliest dinosaurs. Before dinosaurs came along, he was the biggest meat eater on the planet, with a set of teeth to be proud of. So much so, in fact, that Hatty's display is all about the postosuchus's teeth - except they've all gone missing! Andy's mission is to track down a postosuchus and make himself some plaster copies of its teeth. Not an easy task, given it would happily take a bite out of him given half a chance!

In this episode, Abbey is at home with former Sugababe Heidi Range to find out how she's turned a Victorian laundry factory into a stunning family home, and she also knocks on the door of former supermodel, racing car driver and presenter Jodie Kidd, who reveals how she's lovingly restored a 15th-century chocolate box cottage into a cosy home.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: It's the end of an era - Dan Edgar's bachelor pad, scene of some of the most infamous afterparties in Essex, is closing its doors and being relaunched in a new guise. It's now Dan and Amber's flat, and she's wasted no time in adding some female flourishes - Dan's about to swap nights on the Xbox with Diags for couples' dinner parties, but before he does, he invites the lads over to say goodbye to the flat properly. programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: It's time to move with Vince Taylor as he performs Whole Lotta Twisting.

programme.title: Born Of The Sea
programme.desc: 1949. A mysterious baby is found in a boat at sea, along with a charming portrait of a community in Coverack. Where is he from? Stars Dorothea Paul Directed by Anthony Mavrogordato. [S]

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: The Malignant Hearts. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E25)

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. Two Of A Kind. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Trial of Madame X
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Paul England. Stars Mara Russell-Tavernan, Frank Hawkins & Edward Leslie. A philandering wife thrown out of home by her husband later finds herself accused of murder. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Groove along to British pop group The Avons and their song Do It With You (I Wanna Do It).

programme.title: Part-Time Wife
programme.desc: 1961. Comedy. Directed by Max Varnel. Stars Anton Rodgers, Nyree Dawn Porter & Kenneth J. Warren. A husband 'loans' his wife to his bachelor friend who needs to make a good impression. [S]

programme.title: Murder In Reverse
programme.desc: 1945. Crime. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars William Hartnell, Jimmy Hanley & Chili Bouchier. After a long imprisonment, a man wrongfully framed for murder hunts for the truth and the killer. [S]

programme.title: The Silent Invasion
programme.desc: 1962. War. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Eric Flynn, Petra Davies, Francis De Wolff. When the Nazis take over a small village during WWII, a local girl inadvertently falls in love with an officer. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: Across the Dust
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Richard Kinon. Stars Phil Arnold, Lloyd Bridges & Lou Krugman. A frontiersman is asked to lead a wagon train across the vast western prairie in search of a guide. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of Albert Watson V.C. 1966. Stars John Barrie, Charles Morgan & Ronald Lacey. Sergeant Cork is taken hostage by Albert Watson, a man who received the Victoria Cross for bravery in India. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Gentleman Jack and the Lady. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Hazel Court & Peter Hammond. Tempest clashes with a French privateer as they scheme against each other to win a prize. [S]

programme.title: Beyond the Time Barrier
programme.desc: 1960. Sci-fi. Directed by Edgar G. Ulmer. Stars Robert Clarke & Darlene Tompkins. A military test pilot is propelled into the future where he finds a plague has sterilised the world's population. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Put your dancing shoes on and take a step back in time for Eden Kane's Someone Wants to Know.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Extradition. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Phil Brown and Robert Shaw. Maguire must serve a warrant to an American gangster seeking sanctuary in England to ensure he is sent back to the US. [S]

programme.title: Hour of Decision
programme.desc: 1957. Crime. Stars Lionel Jeffries & Hazel Court. Reporter Joe (Jeff Morrow) finds his wife is the prime suspect in a murder investigation. [S]

programme.title: Mark of The Phoenix
programme.desc: 1957. Crime drama directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Anton Diffring. Crooks steal a secret metal formula and plan to smuggle it into East Germany. [S]

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Bobby Crush, Jenny Hanley, Mike Read, Joan Sims, Bernie Winters & Lena Zavaroni. [S]

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Summer River Fishing/Village Fair. 1981. In the heat of a summer's day Jack goes fishing for roach in a drought-stricken river. He then visits his local village fair where they celebrate the past. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1953. The Drayton Case. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Victor Platt & Vincent Ball. The aftermath of a wartime air raid reveals the body of a murdered woman. (S1, E01)

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's...
programme.desc: ...A Man Called Harry Brent. The Third Person. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Alan enlists the help of Carol to set a trap for the killer. [S]

programme.title: Travelling Man
programme.desc: A Token Attempt. 1985. Stars Leigh Lawson, Dee Sadler & Terry Taplin. Lomax is persuaded by the journalist, Robinson, to help his godchild Billie, who has a drug problem. [S]

programme.title: The Intruder (1953)
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Jack Hawkins, Dennis Price, Michael Medwin, George Cole & Hugh Williams. An ex Colonel catches one of his former men robbing his house and investigates. [S]

programme.title: The Stranglers of Bombay
programme.desc: 1959. Action. Director: Terence Fisher. Stars Guy Rolfe, Allan Cuthbertson & Andrew Cruickshank. A captain lobbies to investigate the criminal Thugee Cult of Kali, an organised crime group. [S]

programme.title: Auntie Lee's Meat Pies
programme.desc: 1992. Comedy. Director: Joseph F. Robertson. Stars Karen Black, Pat Mortia & Kristine Rose. A woman sends her four children out to lure in men, only for them to be killed and made into meat pies.
